_README: Template only. The real files live on the secret server and are not in this repo.
appsettings.Prod.json from the secret server into EWT.Api/ before building.
A publish copies appsettings.<DeployEnv>.json into the dist as appsettings.json;
without it the build stops rather than shipping the wrong configuration.
Every value shown as <from the secret server> is redacted here.

Oracle.// TnsAdmin: Only needed if you switch ConnectionString back to the alias form (Data Source=EWT_CORP_DEV). Null leaves the machine's TNS_ADMIN alone.
Oracle.// Instances: Route segment is the key: /odata/{instance}/{table}. LegacyKey is the suffix from the old EWTOracleConnectionString_* names. Passwords come from user-secrets or environment, never from this file.

// Packages: Our own PL/SQL packages, source of truth in OurPackages/. Verify checks presence, validity and that every instance holds the same version. AutoDeploy issues CREATE OR REPLACE where a package is missing or differs from the file. ON for Dev: the fingerprint now matches what Oracle stores, so a restart with everything current deploys nothing and no session gets ORA-04068. Keep it false for Test and Prod, where a package change should go through the same control as any other release.
